args.sql:
WITH readability_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        catlabel AS article_category,
        difflevel AS complexity_level,
        (
            readsec * LOG(wordlen) / 
            CASE 
                WHEN difflevel ILIKE 'Basic' THEN 1
                WHEN difflevel ILIKE 'Intermediate' THEN 1.5
                WHEN difflevel ILIKE 'Advanced' THEN 2
                ELSE 1.2
            END
        ) AS readability_score,
        (engagement_metrics ->> 'engagement_rate')::NUMERIC AS engagement_rate
    FROM 
        articles
),
average_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        article_category,
        complexity_level,
        AVG(readability_score) AS avg_readability_score,
        AVG(engagement_rate) AS avg_engagement_rate,
        COUNT(*) AS article_count
    FROM 
        readability_scores
    GROUP BY 
        article_category, complexity_level
),
correlation_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        article_category,
        CORR(avg_readability_score, avg_engagement_rate) AS correlation_score
    FROM 
        average_scores
    GROUP BY 
        article_category
)
SELECT 
    a.article_category,
    a.complexity_level,
    a.avg_readability_score,
    a.avg_engagement_rate,
    c.correlation_score,
    a.article_count
FROM 
    average_scores a
JOIN 
    correlation_scores c ON a.article_category = c.article_category;
